notes: v505 — the 🎯 Trade Plan now sits inside the 🛒 buy ticket, so the numbers are in front of you at the moment you decide rather than on a separate screen. Putting them together exposed something worth knowing: the plan had two different meanings for 'risk A$200'. The share count was sized so a TYPICAL DAY moves about that much, but the stop-loss sits two typical days away — so if that stop is actually hit, the loss is roughly DOUBLE the number at the top of the panel. On a A$0.098 share: 33,729 shares, a typical day costs A$200, a stop-out costs about A$405. Both statements were true and neither was wrong, but side by side under a Buy button they read as one promise, and they are not. So the ticket now shows BOTH parcels as buttons: one sized so an ordinary day costs what you chose to risk, one sized so being WRONG costs what you chose to risk (the smaller parcel — and the way the 🤖 auto-pilot has always sized). Each button states what it costs on a normal day AND at a full stop-out, and tapping either fills the ticket. The app does not pick for you, because which one is right depends on what you are sizing for. Nothing here predicts direction. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
